Application Data.NAME: Sunshine Souvenirs, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunshine Souvenirs, LLC operates a retail gift and souvenir shop located in a high-traffic tourist area of Orlando, Florida. The store specializes in a diverse range of locally sourced and imported souvenirs, including apparel, memorabilia, handmade crafts, and traditional Florida gifts. We focus on providing exceptional customer service and creating a welcoming environment for both tourists and locals. Our operations include inventory management practices to minimize theft and loss, as well as employee training programs on loss prevention and safety protocols. The shop features robust security measures, including CCTV and alarm systems. We also maintain an online sales platform, ensuring cyber risk management practices are in place to protect customer data and mitigate cyber liability risks. Seasonal sales fluctuations are anticipated, with peak sales during holidays and tourist events, and we have strategies in place for effective inventory management year-round.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, the shop experienced a theft incident where several high-value souvenir items were stolen. The estimated loss amounted to $1,200, and the incident was reported to the local authorities. The claim is currently under review and is pending resolution. In addition, on June 10, 2023, there was water damage caused by a leaking roof during a heavy rainstorm, resulting in inventory damage valued at $300. This claim has been settled, and the repairs are complete. Total losses reported to date are $1,500.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B - UL Rated Safe, Grade 1, Fire and Burglary Rated
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security watchperson during peak tourist seasons.
